data.name: Pixelate TD
data.detailed_description:
PIXELATE TD - Command Your Hero & Defend Your Castle!

Defend your castle in this retro pixel-art tower defense adventure with hero RPG elements!

PIXELATE TD combines classic tower defense strategy with hero combat and modern multiplayer action. Build powerful towers, command your knight hero, discover fusion towers, and compete against players worldwide in real-time PvP battles.

GAME MODES

• SOLO MODE - Infinite waves with strategic tower placement and hero progression

• VS MODE - Real-time multiplayer battles! Send mercenaries to overwhelm your opponent

• IDLE MODE - Automated tower defense for passive resource gathering

COMMAND YOUR HERO

Take control of a mighty knight hero who fights alongside your towers!

• Click anywhere to move your hero across the battlefield

• Auto-attacks nearby enemies with melee combat

• Gains XP from kills and levels up to become stronger

• Heals when near your castle

• Enhanced by powerful Support Towers

FIVE CORE TOWERS

• Basic Tower - Balanced all-rounder for early defense

• Sniper Tower - Ultra-long range precision attacks

• Cannon Tower - Devastating splash damage to multiple enemies

• Ice Tower - Slow enemies in their tracks

• Lightning Tower - Chain attacks that bounce between targets

TOWER EVOLUTION & FUSION SYSTEM

Unlock powerful advanced towers through evolution!

• Double-tap towers to evolve using 2 nearby towers of the same type

• Discover unique Fusion Towers by evolving mixed tower combinations

• Watch Tower - Longest range with devastating critical hits

• Mortar Tower - Devastating area bombardment

• Storm Tower - Precision lightning across multiple targets

• Blizzard Tower - Spreading frost with chain attacks

• Siege Tower - Tank buster with bonus damage to high HP enemies

• Sharpshooter Tower - Extreme precision long-range attacks

• Permafrost Tower - Permanent freeze with area control

SUPPORT TOWERS - BOOST YOUR HERO

Build special support towers that don't attack enemies but empower your hero!

• Strike Tower - Hero attacks 3 enemies at once

• Haste Tower - Doubles hero attack speed

• Might Tower - Doubles hero attack damage

• Requires resources to unlock these game-changing towers

RESOURCE HARVESTING

Your hero automatically collects resources from scenery objects:

• Trees provide Wood

• Rocks provide Stone

• Water sources provide Water

• Unlock powerful Support Towers with collected resources

DIVERSE ENEMIES

Face different enemy types including speedy scouts, armored tanks, deadly hounds, supply wagons, and massive bosses. Each wave increases in difficulty with mixed enemy compositions.

STRATEGIC CARD REWARDS

After each wave, choose powerful upgrade cards:

• Tower upgrades (range, damage, attack speed)

• Hero upgrades (stats and abilities)

• Resource bonuses (gold, double money)

• Castle repairs and fortifications

• Mercenary enhancements (VS mode only)

REAL-TIME MULTIPLAYER

Join public lobbies or create private rooms for friends. Use the mercenary system to send enemies to your opponent while defending your own castle. Monitor opponent status and race to survive all 10 waves!

KEY FEATURES

• Beautiful pixel art graphics with smooth animations

• Hero RPG progression system with leveling

• Dynamic path generation - every game is different

• Tower evolution and fusion discovery system

• Support towers that enhance hero combat

• Resource gathering and management

• Full sound design with BGM and SFX

• Multi-language support (English, Chinese, Japanese)

• Interactive tutorial for new players

data.short_description: Pixel art tower defense! Challenge infinite waves solo or battle players in 10-wave matches. 5 tower types, 7 enemies, BOSS every 5 waves. Choose upgrade cards after each wave to build your ultimate defense!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD Ryzen 3 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated or dedicated GPU supporting OpenGL 2.1 or DirectX 11
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any standard onboard sound card
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: Recommended to play at 1080p with mouse and keyboard.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i3 (Universal build)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated or dedicated GPU supporting Metal or OpenGL 2.1
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any standard onboard sound card
  • Additional Notes: Compatible with both Apple Silicon and Intel Macs. Best experienced with mouse and keyboard.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or SteamOS 3 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD Ryzen 3 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU supporting OpenGL 2.1 or Vulkan
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any standard onboard sound card
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: Distributed as an AppImage. No installation required.
